name: nsx-backdrop
description: Backdrop picker: /nsx-backdrop <name> sets a sky that follows the clock, a per-project look, a sumi-e ink wash or a pixel-noir skyline, with matching Code tab colors; /nsx-plain clears it.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the sky that follows the clock, such as Asia/Jakarta. Empty: the TZ environment variable, else UTC.
